verdict.rationale: SAM.gov is a government data platform. A natural-language command interface is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only structured REST query parameters, a keyword free-text 'q' search, and an OpenAPI spec. These are developer building blocks and adjacent search features, not a documented way to operate the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
